sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:146156
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31917 of 2023

Applicant :- Dabloo Alias Mohd. Salauddin
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Vimal Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anil Kumar Pandey
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Today, power has been filed on behalf of Sri Anil Pandey, Advocate for informant, which is taken
on record.
2. Heard Sri Vimal Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anil Pandey, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Ravi Kant Kushwaha, learned AGA for the State.

3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 53 of 2022, under Sections 376, 506, 328 IPC, Section 3/4 POCSO Act and Section 67-B of I.T.
Act, Police Station Kasiya, District Kushinagar during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged on 31.01.2022 against applicant and according to the FIR applicant sexually exploited the minor daughter of the informant and also prepared her indecent Dabloo Alias Mohd. Salauddin vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115586083/
1 video and photo and sent the same to her relative.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and although prosecutrix during investigation stated against the applicant but when her statement was recorded by the trial court then she has declared hostile and categorically stated that applicant did not commit rape with her and her mother on the basis of wrong facts lodged FIR of the present case.
He further submits that certified copy of statement of prosecutrix has been annexed along with instant bail application.

He next submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 08.10.2022.
6.
Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that prosecutrix of the case has declared hostile during trial.

7. Learned counsel for the informant also conceded the fact that during trial prosecutrix did not support the prosecution case and has declared hostile and informant and prosecutrix both are not having any objection if applicant be released on bail.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. From the perusal of record, it appears that prosecutrix of the case during trial did not support the prosecution case and has declared hostile and even as per learned counsel for the informant prosecutrix and informant both are not having any objection if applicant be enlarged on bail.

10. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant - Dabloo Alias Mohd. Salauddin be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
13.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
